description: A Flutter widget representing a video detail screen with options to play the video in full-screen or Mini Player mode. It loads video poster images, displays video title, description, and buttons to initiate playback.

classes.name: VideoDetailScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays video details including poster image, title, description, and playback controls.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the video detail screen, including poster image, title, description, and play buttons.
